newsitem.title: UK: LME copper hits fresh high in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper hits fresh high in late trading.

text.p: LME copper explored new upside territory in late inter-office trading, hitting a fresh one-year peak.
At 1830 GMT, three month copper was quoted at $2,373/78 after trading as high as $2,483, up from a afternoon kerb close of $2,463, traders said.
Buying on Comex helped lift prices above the $2,474 high seen in official activity.

After the LME close, news came out that state copper worker in Chile would consider call strike action to protest against the government's report plans to privatise parts of the state oil company Enap and state metals smelting firm Enami.
The other metals were little changed.
